d: Indonesia and Singapore are facing a diplomatic row as toxic haze from forest fires, natural gas supplies and financial market tensions collide. In this video, Firstpost examines how fires across Indonesia’s Sumatra and Kalimantan islands have triggered cross-border pollution concerns, prompting Singapore to investigate companies suspected of links to the blazes.
